kenshi: roic/roicg維持: 検死参考計算はFY2025 ROIC(のれん除き)=68.9% / ROIC(込み)=54.5%。ドラフトroic71.1/roicg52.9は採取器値を維持(NOPAT/IC定義差だが同水準の高ROIC・再現整合)
gm=31.6は営業利益率(opm)。GrossProfit÷売上は61.8%だが本欄はASR同様opmを格納。opm 2024 29.0→2025 31.6でgmt=up整合
nde検算: 純負債=総債務450+当期75-現金180.1=約345M ÷ EBITDA(op1360+dep145)1505 = 0.23 ≒ ドラフト0.18。いずれも<1。純現金ではない
『純現金/負資本』前提は不成立: 自己資本eq FY2025=$1,448Mで正(過去は自社株買いで圧縮、2019 eq=$177M)。純負債も約$345M存在→p3は純現金95でなく<1帯の85
sbc充填: SBC$60.0M÷売上$4,303.7M=1.4%(index仕様=SBC÷売上%)。dilNet=-1.3%は自社株買いによる株数純減(希薄化コスト軽微)
acq5=yes: FY2021買収$173.4M≒総資産$2,437Mの7.1%(>5%基準該当)。ただしのれん$414M(総資産12%)は小さく、のれん込/除ROIC乖離(54.5%対68.9%)は限定的で実質オーガニック
p1: ROIC(込み)5年σ=6.4pt(37.4-54.5%)。<6pt帯を僅かに超過するが37-55%の高ROIC基準では相対変動小→78
p2: XBRL窓内の不況はCOVID(2020)のみ。営利2019 552.8→2020 694.5(+26%)で不況耐性(ペット医療の非裁量需要)。2008-09は系列外→単一不況サンプルにつき浅DD95相当を90へ保守化
f1(ROIIC): ΔNOPAT(2023→25)=約+$215Mに対しΔIC≒-11M(自社株買いで投下資本ほぼ横ばい)→ROIIC実質青天井。2022→25基準でも83.6%>>WACC+15。資本極小の増分経済→90(還元中心のため再投資率加点は非該当)
f2/f3/f4はhitsに数値開示なく保守側: f2=65(TAM浸透率の明示なし)、f3=75(シェア趨勢+のみ確定、R&D/売上比は未開示)、f4=80(非CAG隣接=水質/家畜/SaaS/画像がhitsで成長明示・従来>5%規模)

evidence.expiry: 『Although certain of these patents and licenses are expected to expire in future years, the expiration of these patents and licenses, individually or in the aggregate, is not expected to have a material adverse effect』→堀は特許依存でなく設置基盤依存→no
evidence.moatdecay: 『12% growth in our installed base of premium instruments, which reflected new customers and continued high customer retention rates』→基盤拡大・堀健全→no
evidence.erosion: 『high customer retention rates』『installed base... Catalyst 78/74/69(2025/24/23)』で設置基盤は増勢。蝕の競争激化は将来語りの定型リスク文→none
evidence.disrupt: 『We face intense competition, and we expect that competition will further intensify as new products, services and technologies become available, the use of AI and machine learning expands』→技術代替は未決着→unsettled
evidence.dom: 『Sales of consumables to customers who use our chemistry analyzers provide the majority of our instrument consumables revenues from our installed base of IDEXX VetLab instruments』『12% growth in our installed base... continued high customer retention rates』→設置基盤+リカーリング支配。ただしhitsに明示的市場シェア%なし→圧倒帯85で保守化
evidence.irr: 『grow our installed base of instruments, and increase demand for related recurring sales of consumable products, services, and accessories』『multi-year customer commitments to purchase recurring products and services』→設置機器+専有消耗品による高摩擦移行→70
evidence.rep: 『Our large practice management systems installed base provides access to veterinary channel transaction activity, enabling a syndicated data offering』+『our manufacturing know-how』→数十年の設置基盤・メニュー・データ網で複製極困難→80
evidence.dur: 『commitment arrangements in exchange for multi-year customer commitments to purchase recurring products and services』+専有消耗品の設置基盤ロック→スイッチングコスト主体→75
evidence.geopol: 『We are a global business, with 36% of our revenue during the year ended December 31, 2025, attributable to sales of products and services to customers outside of the U.S.』+『sole or single-source suppliers, such as Ortho』+tariffs言及→中程度→1
evidence.p4: 誠の『material weakness』ヒットは監査手続の定型記述(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, and testing and evaluating...』)で実指摘ではない。『ITEM 1B. UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS Not applicable』→無限定+accr<0→90
evidence.nrr: 開示なし→既定105。リカーリング消耗品モデル・高リテンションだがhitsに具体NRR値なし
